bookmark_status.description: Bookmark a post for this account. Bookmarks are private - nobody else is told - and, unlike favourites, they are not sent to the author.

follow_account.description: Follow an account. A locked account turns this into a request instead: what comes back then has 'requested' set and 'following' clear, and nothing is followed until its owner approves.

lookup_account.description: Find an account by handle and get its ID, which the other account actions take. This only finds accounts the instance already knows about; for an account nobody here has ever seen, use Search with 'Fetch from other instances' on.
lookup_account.name: lookup_account

parameters.description: The handle to look up: 'someone' for an account on this instance, '@someone@mastodon.social' for one elsewhere. Not an ID.
parameters.name: acct

post_status.description: Publish a post, optionally as a reply, with a content warning, with a poll, or scheduled for later. Scheduling changes what comes back: a scheduled post's ID belongs to the schedule, not to a published post, and the other post actions cannot use it.
post_status.name: post_status

parameters.description: The text of the post. The instance decides the length limit - 500 characters unless its admins raised it.
parameters.name: status

parameters.description: Defaults to whatever the account's own posting default is.
parameters.name: visibility

parameters.description: Shown in place of the post until the reader opens it. Leave empty for no warning.
parameters.name: spoiler_text

parameters.description: Hide the post behind a click-to-view.
parameters.name: sensitive

parameters.description: The post this one replies to. Paste its link or use an ID from an earlier step. Leave empty to start a new thread.
parameters.name: in_reply_to_id

parameters.description: The language the post is written in. Pick one of the instance's languages or type any two-letter code, such as 'de' or 'pt-BR'.
parameters.name: language

parameters.description: Publish later instead of now. Must be at least five minutes from now.
parameters.name: scheduled_at

parameters.description: Turn the post into a poll by giving at least two answers. Most instances allow four.
parameters.name: poll_options

parameters.description: How long the poll stays open.
parameters.name: poll_expires_in

parameters.description: Let a voter choose more than one answer.
parameters.name: poll_multiple

parameters.description: Keep the vote counts hidden while it runs.
parameters.name: poll_hide_totals

reblog_status.description: Boost a post to this account's followers. What comes back is the boost itself; the post that was boosted is inside it, under 'reblog'. A boost cannot be direct, so this offers three visibilities where publishing offers four.
reblog_status.name: reblog_status

parameters.description: The post to act on. Paste the link to the post, or use an ID from an earlier step.
parameters.name: status_id

parameters.description: Defaults to public.
parameters.name: visibility

search.description: Search this instance for accounts, hashtags and posts. An empty 'statuses' list is normal: searching the full text of other people's posts needs the instance to run Elasticsearch, and without it Mastodon only matches this account's own posts and anything it can resolve as a link.
search.name: search

parameters.description: What to look for: words, a handle, a hashtag, or the link to a post or profile.
parameters.name: query

parameters.description: Narrow the search to one kind of result. Leave empty to get all three.
parameters.name: search_type

parameters.description: Look a handle or link up on its own server when this instance has not seen it before. Needed to find an account nobody here follows yet.
parameters.name: resolve

parameters.description: Leave out accounts this account does not follow.
parameters.name: following

parameters.description: Keep only posts written by this account. A handle, a profile link or an account ID.
parameters.name: account

parameters.description: Leave out hashtags the instance's moderators have not reviewed.
parameters.name: exclude_unreviewed

parameters.description: How many accounts, posts and hashtags to return each, up to 40.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Skip this many results to read a further page. Only works alongside 'Only look for'.
parameters.name: offset
